key_highlights: ASX shook off early weakness following Wall Street volatility, closing slightly firmer despite global headwinds.
ANZ posted a $7.6b full-year profit, but flagged climbing mortgage delinquencies as restrictive monetary policy bites households.
Macro headwinds persist as Australia experiences its steepest housing downturn, compounding RBA policy pressure and AUD depreciation.
Commodities remain mixed: iron ore searches for support, oil faces protracted recovery, while domestic gas milestones advance in the Beetaloo.

sectors.trend: Strong headline earnings offset by worsening asset quality and rising mortgage arrears.
sectors.implications: Net interest margins remain supported but credit impairment charges and rising arrears among overleveraged borrowers pose medium-term earnings risk for major banks.

sectors.trend: Fragile iron ore demand counterbalanced by exploration momentum in gold and critical minerals.
sectors.implications: Margin compression threatens high-cost iron ore producers, while gold equities benefit from safe-haven demand amid currency and market volatility.

sectors.trend: Weak global crude outlook contrasted with domestic gas regulatory milestones.
sectors.implications: Downstream upstream divergence persists; oil majors face revenue drag, but Beetaloo basin operators gain commercialization certainty.

sectors.trend: Accelerating nationwide housing price declines and structural stress on retail mall anchors.
sectors.implications: Residential developers face sharp margin erosion, while retail landlord REITs must accelerate tenancy repositioning away from traditional department stores.

sectors.trend: Regulatory scrutiny mounting over data centre approvals, grid capacity, and international tech volatility.
sectors.implications: Potential moratoriums could delay project rollouts and increase power connection costs for data centre operators and infrastructure funds.

key_themes: Monetary policy transmission lagging, intensifying stress on indebted households and mortgage holders.
Sharp residential property downturn impacting bank balance sheets and consumer spending.
AUD depreciation amplifying imported inflation while bolstering local commodity export receipts in AUD terms.
Global equity market spillovers and tech valuation recalibrations testing ASX market resilience.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight exposed regional lenders; favour diversified banks with conservative provisioning and high capital buffers.
Hedge FX exposures or tilt towards offshore revenue earners (healthcare, global resources) to capitalise on translation gains.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: China/Global Growth Slowdown Weighing on Bulk Commodities
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour lowest-quartile cash cost iron ore and diversified producers over single-commodity junior miners.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Data Centre Infrastructure & Energy Grid Constraints
risk_assessment.mitigation: Target operators with secured power allocations and renewable power purchase agreements.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate low-cost gold producers and critical minerals plays
opportunities.rationale: High-grade resource upgrades and AUD weakness offer expanding operating margins and defensive hedging.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to domestic natural gas exploration and infrastructure
opportunities.rationale: Licensing milestones in the Beetaloo Basin de-risk long-term supply into tight domestic and regional gas markets.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to discretionary retail and mall-anchored REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Department store contraction and household financial strain signal extended headwinds for retail footfall and rents.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Rotate into defensive, USD-earning healthcare and quality large-cap defensives
defensive_moves.rationale: Protects against Australian property market fallout, domestic recessionary risks, and local currency depreciation.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX expected to trade in a volatile sideways range as domestic credit deterioration and Wall Street turbulence cap upside.
market_outlook.long_term: Gradual recovery predicated on monetary easing cycles, housing price stabilization, and steadying resource export demand.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate statements and commentary on household debt stress
Quarterly Australian CPI and retail trade releases
Chinese industrial production data and stimulus updates for steel/iron ore
Major bank quarterly updates on 90+ day mortgage arrears and impairment provisions
watch_list: AUD/USD exchange rate breaking key technical supports
Iron ore 62% Fe spot price FOB Port Hedland
National dwelling price indices and mortgage default rates
Global crude oil benchmarks and regional gas realization prices
